title: GraphQL Pagination
description: Implement Relay-style cursor pagination with first, after cursor, totalCount, and category filtering.

steps.title: Paginated posts query
steps.description: Create a query { posts(first: 2) { edges { node { title } } } } that returns the first 2 posts.
hints: Define a Post type with id and title
Create a PostConnection type with edges
Implement pagination logic to slice the posts array

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from graphene import ObjectType, Int, String, Boolean, List, Schema, Field
from fastapi_gql import GQL
import base64

posts_data = [
    {'id': 1, 'title': 'Post A'},
    {'id': 2, 'title': 'Post B'},
    {'id': 3, 'title': 'Post C'},
    {'id': 4, 'title': 'Post D'}
]

class Post(ObjectType):
    id = Int()
    title = String()

class PageInfo(ObjectType):
    hasNextPage = Boolean()
    endCursor = String()

class PostEdge(ObjectType):
    node = Field(Post)
    cursor = String()

class PostConnection(ObjectType):
    edges = List(PostEdge)
    pageInfo = Field(PageInfo)

class Query(ObjectType):
    posts = Field(PostConnection, first=Int(required=True))

    def resolve_posts(self, info, first):
        sliced = posts_data[:first]
        edges = []
        for p in sliced:
            cursor = base64.b64encode(str(p['id']).encode()).decode()
            edges.append(PostEdge(node=Post(**p), cursor=cursor))
        end_cursor = edges[-1].cursor if edges else None
        return PostConnection(
            edges=edges,
            pageInfo=PageInfo(hasNextPage=first < len(posts_data), endCursor=end_cursor)
        )

schema = Schema(query=Query)
app = FastAPI()
GQL(app, schema=schema)

from fastapi import FastAPI
from graphene import ObjectType, Int, String, Boolean, List, Schema, Field
from fastapi_gql import GQL
import base64

posts_data = [
    {'id': 1, 'title': 'Post A'},
    {'id': 2, 'title': 'Post B'},
    {'id': 3, 'title': 'Post C'},
    {'id': 4, 'title': 'Post D'}
]

class Post(ObjectType):
    id = Int()
    title = String()

class PageInfo(ObjectType):
    hasNextPage = Boolean()
    endCursor = String()

class PostEdge(ObjectType):
    node = Field(Post)
    cursor = String()

class PostConnection(ObjectType):
    edges = List(PostEdge)
    pageInfo = Field(PageInfo)
    totalCount = Int()

class Query(ObjectType):
    posts = Field(PostConnection, first=Int(required=True), after=String())

    def resolve_posts(self, info, first, after=None):
        start_index = 0
        if after:
            decoded = int(base64.b64decode(after).decode())
            for i, p in enumerate(posts_data):
                if p['id'] == decoded:
                    start_index = i + 1
                    break
        sliced = posts_data[start_index:start_index + first]
        edges = []
        for p in sliced:
            cursor = base64.b64encode(str(p['id']).encode()).decode()
            edges.append(PostEdge(node=Post(**p), cursor=cursor))
        end_cursor = edges[-1].cursor if edges else None
        return PostConnection(
            edges=edges,
            totalCount=len(posts_data),
            pageInfo=PageInfo(hasNextPage=(start_index + first) < len(posts_data), endCursor=end_cursor)
        )

schema = Schema(query=Query)
app = FastAPI()
GQL(app, schema=schema)

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from graphene import ObjectType, Int, String, Boolean, List, Schema, Field
from fastapi_gql import GQL
import base64

posts_data = [
    {'id': 1, 'title': 'Post A', 'category': 'tech'},
    {'id': 2, 'title': 'Post B', 'category': 'science'},
    {'id': 3, 'title': 'Post C', 'category': 'tech'},
    {'id': 4, 'title': 'Post D', 'category': 'science'}
]

class Post(ObjectType):
    id = Int()
    title = String()
    category = String()

class PageInfo(ObjectType):
    hasNextPage = Boolean()
    endCursor = String()

class PostEdge(ObjectType):
    node = Field(Post)
    cursor = String()

class PostConnection(ObjectType):
    edges = List(PostEdge)
    pageInfo = Field(PageInfo)
    totalCount = Int()

class Query(ObjectType):
    posts = Field(PostConnection, first=Int(required=True), after=String(), category=String())

    def resolve_posts(self, info, first, after=None, category=None):
        filtered = posts_data
        if category:
            filtered = [p for p in posts_data if p['category'] == category]
        start_index = 0
        if after:
            decoded = int(base64.b64decode(after).decode())
            for i, p in enumerate(filtered):
                if p['id'] == decoded:
                    start_index = i + 1
                    break
        sliced = filtered[start_index:start_index + first]
        edges = []
        for p in sliced:
            cursor = base64.b64encode(str(p['id']).encode()).decode()
            edges.append(PostEdge(node=Post(**p), cursor=cursor))
        end_cursor = edges[-1].cursor if edges else None
        return PostConnection(
            edges=edges,
            totalCount=len(filtered),
            pageInfo=PageInfo(hasNextPage=(start_index + first) < len(filtered), endCursor=end_cursor)
        )

schema = Schema(query=Query)
app = FastAPI()
GQL(app, schema=schema)
